name: pr-conventions
description: Pull request and commit message conventions

interface.shortDescription: Pull request and commit message conventions
interface.longDescription: Gitmoji-style PR titles, Conventional Commits message format, atomic-commit discipline, and a hook that blocks AI/co-author attribution footers from commit messages and PR descriptions. Also a workflow for reviewing someone else's PR with inline comments in a pending review, and a hook that blocks long or itemised review bodies and unpreviewed submits.
defaultPrompt: Write a gitmoji-style title and Conventional Commits message for this change
